name: 98391 · Bonney Lake, WA
findings: ZIP 98391 (Bonney Lake) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98391 (Bonney Lake) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98391 (Bonney Lake) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).
